characters.title: Characters
characters.description: Characters are unique fighters with different base attacks and passive abilities that help you in battle

abilities.title: Abilities
abilities.description: Abilities are powers you unlock during the fight that can synergize and fuze with each other to make you stronger

fates.title: Fates
fates.description: The Knots of Fate allows players to shape their build dynamically during a run.

ballista.title: Ballista
ballista.description: Summon a ballista periodically shooting salvos at nearby enemies.

dagger_throw.title: Dagger Throw
dagger_throw.description: Throw sharp daggers towards random targets making enemies bleed.

fenrirs_claws.title: Fenrir's Claws
fenrirs_claws.description: Fenrir brutally slashes through random targets.

ferocious_stomp.title: Ferocious Stomp
ferocious_stomp.description: Unleash a ferocious Stomp damaging enemies around you and stuns them for 3 seconds.

hammer_of_the_righteous.title: Hammer of the Righteous
hammer_of_the_righteous.description: Throw the Hammers of the Righteous that spin around their target location.

hugin_and_munin.title: Hugin and Munin
hugin_and_munin.description: Call Hugin and Munin to your side, damaging enemies around you.

ride_of_the_valkyries.title: Ride of the Valkyries
ride_of_the_valkyries.description: Valkyries periodically ride through the battlefield damaging enemies in their paths.

shattering_ground.title: Shattering Ground
shattering_ground.description: Shatter the ground towards a random target.

spear_of_the_elder.title: Spear of the Elder
spear_of_the_elder.description: Throw a spear at a random target damaging close enemies on impact. When collecting the spear you swing it around, damaging and knocking back enemies.

whirl_slash.title: Whirl Slash
whirl_slash.description: Rapidly whirl your sword around you.

ember_axe.title: Ember Axe
ember_axe.description: Throw exploding axes towards random targets.

fiery_rune.title: Fiery Rune
fiery_rune.description: Marks an enemy with a rune that explodes after a short time.

firewolfs_fury.title: Firewolf's Fury
firewolfs_fury.description: Summon the Firewolf's Fury, a blazing wolf spirit attacking enemies alongside you.

flamebound_leech.title: Flamebound Leech
flamebound_leech.description: Burn targeted enemies from the inside and heal for 1% of the damage dealt.

flesh-searing_heat.title: Flesh-Searing Heat
flesh-searing_heat.description: Create a persistent aura around you that inflicts damage and ignites enemies.

giants_tooth.title: Giant's Tooth
giants_tooth.description: Pierce random targets with massive spears.

jotunfire_outburst.title: Jotunfire Outburst
jotunfire_outburst.description: Summon fiery vulcanos periodically bursting out.

magma_sphere.title: Magma Sphere
magma_sphere.description: Hurl a slow-moving magma sphere towards your cursor position, leaving a trail of fire behind.

molten_trap.title: Molten Trap
molten_trap.description: Place a molten trap beneath you that triggers a rotating firebeam upon enemy contact.

surturs_inferno.title: Surtur's Inferno
surturs_inferno.description: Summon fire tornados roaming around on the battlefield.

arctic_assault.title: Arctic Assault
arctic_assault.description: Massive pieces of ice dropping from the sky and detonating on random locations.

bone-chilling_cold.title: Bone-Chilling Cold
bone-chilling_cold.description: Create a persistent aura around you that slows enemies and applies the Chill effect.

flurry_of_knives.title: Flurry of Knives
flurry_of_knives.description: Throw icy knives in the target direction, hitting enemies in quick succession.

frost_orbit.title: Frost Orbit
frost_orbit.description: Summon icicles orbiting around you and damaging nearby enemies

frost_trap.title: Frost Trap
frost_trap.description: Places a frost trap beneath you that triggers piercing projectiles upon enemy contact.

glacial_sunder.title: Glacial Sunder
glacial_sunder.description: Frost spikes erupt from the ground at random targets.

leviathan_axe_throw.title: Leviathan Axe Throw
leviathan_axe_throw.description: Throw the Leviathan Axe towards a random target, lingering at the position before returning back.

skadis_ice_arrow.title: Skadi's Ice Arrow
skadis_ice_arrow.description: Shoot ice arrows towards random targets, freezing them in place.

ymirs_avalanche.title: Ymir's Avalanche
ymirs_avalanche.description: Roll a snowball towards the target direction. The snowball grows in size and increases it's damage the bigger it gets.

gungir.title: Gungir
gungir.description: Throw Gungnir at a random target, exploding on impact.

lokis_electric_mirage.title: Loki's Electric Mirage
lokis_electric_mirage.description: Create afterimages of lightning which slowly move to a random target and detonate when touched by an enemy.

mjolnir.title: Mjölnir
mjolnir.description: Throw the mighty Mjölnir in a random direction, ricocheting off enemies.

serpents_coil.title: Serpents Coil
serpents_coil.description: Call a electrifying serpent from the ground damaging enemies in its way.

thors_wrath.title: Thor's Wrath
thors_wrath.description: Call lightning from the sky hitting random targets and the surroundings.

thunderous_tether.title: Thunderous Tether
thunderous_tether.description: Place a lightning gem near you creating a electrical chain between you and the gem. Enemies touching the chain take damage.

tyrs_judgement.title: Tyr's Judgement
tyrs_judgement.description: Call Tyr's Greatsword emitting electric shocks to random targets.

yggdrasils_pulse.title: Yggdrasil's Pulse
yggdrasils_pulse.description: Hurl a slow moving electric pulse towards your cursor position.

burning_chaos_blades.title: Burning Chaos Blades
burning_chaos_blades.description: Swing burning Chaos Blades around you damaging, igniting and making enemies bleed.

electrified_axes.title: Electrified Axes
electrified_axes.description: Throw electrified flaming axes that explode and create afterimages of themselves on impact.

frostfang_ring.title: Frostfang Ring
frostfang_ring.description: Summon a giant frost wall around you errupting from the ground and moving outwards.

helstorm.title: Helstorm
helstorm.description: Summon flaming tornados infused with frost from Hel shooting out piercing icicles.

odins_ice_arrows.title: Odin's Ice Arrows
odins_ice_arrows.description: Shoot Odin's icy arrows towards random targets, freezing them in place, exploding and applying shock on impact.

shattering_leviathan_axe.title: Shattering Leviathan Axe
shattering_leviathan_axe.description: Throw the Leviathan Axe towards a random target, lingering at the position before returning back. From the heavy swing it periodically launches shattered pieces into a random direction.

stormpiercer.title: Stormpiercer
stormpiercer.description: Summon the Stormpiercer, periodically shooting electric pulses at nearby enemies.

thunderclaw.title: Thunderclaw
thunderclaw.description: Fenrir gets infused with electric energy and slashes brutally through random targets.

warrior.title: Warrior
warrior.playstyle: Excels in close-range combat with high survivability and area control. Perfect for players who want to dive into the action and absorb hits while dishing out heavy damage.
warrior.trait2: Often benefits from AoE effects and self-sustain

huntress.title: Huntress
huntress.role: Agile ranged fighter and precision killer.
huntress.playstyle: Ideal for players who enjoy mobility and keeping distance from enemies while dealing consistent damage with projectiles.
huntress.trait2: Specializes in crits, traps, or piercing effects and arrows

seer.title: Seer
seer.playstyle: Uses mystical powers to apply debilitating effects and control the battlefield over time. A strategic choice for players who enjoy layering bleed, burn, shock, and other conditions to weaken enemies before finishing them off.
seer.trait2: Strong synergy with elemental or status-based builds

bloodveil.title: Bloodveil
bloodveil.description: Bloodveil is the first weapon / ability the hero gets and belongs to the Warrior.

mistbane.title: Mistbane
mistbane.description: Mistbane is the second weapon / ability the hero gets and belongs to the Huntress.

curseweaver.title: Curseweaver
curseweaver.description: Curseweaver is the third weapon / ability the hero gets and belongs to the Seer.
